title: Coverage Manifest Entry
description: One per-paper row in the coverage audit report produced by scripts/02_check_coverage.py, recording what source material (main PDF, supplement) exists for a paper and its fulltext extraction status before pipeline extraction (stage 5) begins.

zotero_key.description: The Zotero item key (8-character alphanumeric ID) for this paper — the canonical identifier used throughout the project instead of filename or DOI.

doi.description: DOI of the paper, if known. Null if not recorded in Zotero metadata.

year.description: Publication year of the paper. Null if not recorded in Zotero metadata.

has_main_pdf.description: Whether a main-text PDF for this paper is present in the data root.

has_supplement.description: Whether any supplementary material for this paper is present in the data root.

supplement_type.description: File format of the supplementary material, if any. 'mixed' means more than one format is present (e.g. both a PDF and a docx supplement). Null or 'none' if has_supplement is false.

fulltext_status.description: Status of fulltext extraction for this paper: 'ok' if main text was extracted cleanly, 'ocr_needed' if the PDF is image-based and requires OCR, 'missing' if no source file could be found, 'paywalled' if the source could not be retrieved due to access restrictions.

flag.description: Free-text note for manual review (e.g. 'check manually', 'upload needed'). Null if no manual review is needed.
